basic_info.description: Built in 1950 and set against stunning Pacific Ocean views, this beautifully maintained mid-century modern home captures the spirit of the era's design, characterized by simplicity, functionality and integration with nature. Expansive windows and open, interconnected living spaces make colorful sunsets, ocean breezes, and beautiful landscapes an important part of daily life.   Throughout the home, timeless architectural elements such as clean lines, geometric shapes, custom built-ins, hardwood floors and expansive floor-to-ceiling windows invite harmony and a feeling of peace and comfort. With extensively renovated systems, the home offers upgraded electrical and HVAC, a newer roof with copper gutters, and all copper plumbing. Keeping up with modern efficiency, there is a solar panel system, an EV charging station, in-ground irrigation, whole house sound and home security systems. You'll enjoy natural interplay from the inside out through the windows of the sunroom that overlook professionally landscaped gardens, and from the large family room that opens to the yard's charming brick patio.  Situated on a prime view lot, the home is steps away from Terrace Green Park, West Portal shops, restaurants and transportation, great schools, Stonestown Galleria and Highways 280 and 101.
